question: Which of the following dances is traditionally performed by tea cultivators in Assam?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jhumur.**____** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jhumur** is a traditional dance form of** the "Adivasi"** group of Assam.
 
• Jhumair is an** Indian folk dance** beginning in the Indian states of **Bihar, Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, Odisha and West Bengal. **
 
• It is a folk dance of** Sadan, the Indo-Aryan ethnic** categories of Chotanagpur.
 
• **West Bengal **is the site of the beginning of jhumur music, and later on, it spread out to the border region of Bangladesh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The very famous folk dance of Assam is famous as** Bihu**, the native folk dance.
 
• **​Bhortal Nritya** is among the most zealous dance forms in Assam.
 
• **Deodhani dance** is a Shaman folk dance from the **Indian state of Assam.**
